title: Utopia Conflict
core_loop: enter the city -> choose a visible field activity or capture route -> fight with hardlight weapons -> secure nodes / open Vector Arena -> earn points -> upgrade body, armor, or ammo -> continue district activities

controls.swap_weapon: TAB cycles right hand; Q cycles left hand; number keys select right; Shift+number selects left
controls.help: F1 opens the modal Field Reference and pauses city play while open
controls.menu: ESC opens true pause/settings; W/S or Up/Down selects; Enter/Space activates; mouse buttons remain clickable; ESC resumes
controls.exit: ESC then Quit to Desktop; 0 remains a direct debug/legacy exit binding
controls.interact: E starts a nearby visible activity station or enters an open Vector Arena portal; signal fragments can still be walked into or shot
controls.weapon_slots: 1 Core Lance, 2 Imploder, 3 Proximity Magnet, 4 Disassembler, 5 Burst Splitter, 6 Auto Lattice
controls.district_travel: travel north from spawn to enter High Towers; travel east to enter Pyramid Sector
controls.arena_portal: E enters/exits Vector Arena portal when in range
controls.upgrades: U buys ammo capacity; Shift+U buys health capacity; I buys armor shell capacity using shared points
controls.activity_stations: Calibration: Core Sample and Imploder Study; High Towers: Shield Fracture; Pyramid Sector: Magnet Garden
controls.hud: H toggles the minimal gameplay HUD
controls.presentation_launch: Normal direct launch opens a deploy briefing; Enter deploys, F1 opens Field Reference, ESC opens settings

score_rules.score_source: node captures, signal fragments, weapon kills, arena waves, arena clears, chain ruptures, extraction bonus
score_rules.complete_when: all command nodes are captured, required signal fragments are recovered, and the return lattice is reached
score_rules.save_scope: local mission/game result packet; Prototype Lab validates and saves shared points when launched from the Lab
score_rules.upgrade_spend: shared local points earned in city and arena can be spent on ammo capacity, health capacity, and armor shell capacity

mission_contract.save_ownership_rule: Mission owns local result; Prototype Lab validates before adding shared points.

origin_note: Former extracted dimension branch. Current branch is a jump-in Prototype Lab mission, not a wrapped mode.
notes: Pass55 pause-menu input repair: pause/settings is now operable by keyboard as well as DirectGUI mouse buttons, with visible selection and an explicit control hint. Pass54 presentation readiness remains preserved.
summary: Vector/hardlight combat city with visible field activities, district capture routes, Vector Arena instances, and wireframe health/armor feedback.

weapon_variants.1: Core Lance: starting weak-core beam with recharge and pass-through pierce on core kills
weapon_variants.2: Imploder: command-node unlock; pulls enemies inward, then fires a delayed crush aftershock
weapon_variants.3: Proximity Magnet: signal unlock; deploys pull fields with visible tethers and center-crush damage
weapon_variants.4: Disassembler: late unlock; targets head/arms/legs based on aim and slows enemies as parts detach
weapon_variants.5: Burst Splitter: scatter lattice added in Pass16
weapon_variants.6: Auto Lattice: automatic line stream added in Pass16

activity_mode.activity_score: Four physical field activities award Lab points and keep their district-specific placement

name: Utopia Conflict

districts.calibration: start zone; balanced ammo drops for all weapons
districts.pyramid_sector: east zone; favors Imploder, Proximity Magnet, and Burst Splitter ammo
districts.high_towers: north zone; favors Core Lance, Disassembler, and Auto Lattice ammo

arena_mode.entry: portal opens after a capture node is secured
arena_mode.shared_assets: uses Utopia Conflict weapon/audio systems plus staged Vector Arena SFX

health_and_armor_readability.health_readout: weapon/armor wireframe color gradient, not a health bar
health_and_armor_readability.body_gradient: green full -> amber mid -> red empty
health_and_armor_readability.armor_readout: cyan wireframe shell; hit damage exposes/fades toward current body-health color
